scope: Current production pressure-predictor solver on SAVED pre-change states and seeds only. No facade call, prefix recapture, initializer, feed flash, phase correction, support rederivation during a solve, or outer fallback. Strict fresh audit and final-step certificate determine accepted. No timing claims.
deadlineContract: Single-threaded cooperative deadline; checkpoint latency can exceed the requested bound. Thread interruption aborts the run unchanged; an owned attempt timeout records its latest trace and permits the next case.
traceContract: Samples are callback observations, not accepted-step counts. Rejected frozen-FD retries may repeat an iteration/state. regularizedDirection counts only the stagnation-triggered alternative considered/chosen, not ordinary line-search-failure recovery. No stored convergence certificate is trusted as a new certificate.
